player_prompt.intro:
U n'wi {player_id} eka michezo ya Indian Poker.
- Deki ya 52 khadi; u vona khadi ya muphikisi ntsena.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) hi ku ringana, {max_rounds} ringana(s) hinkwato.
- Mipheto yo pfumeleka: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X i nambari ya nkoka <= ku hundzuka kwa chip ya wena.)
- Khadi ya le henhla i winile pot eka ku kombisa.

round.announce:
### Mpikwa {current_round}/{max_rounds}
Khadi ya muphikisi wako i: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Nika hi action ya kubracketed emoyeni, k.b. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', kuya '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: A swi nge endleki [check] - u langutane ni ku beja.
invalid_move.amount_min: Ntsengo wa ku beja / wo tlakusa mali wu fanele wu ri ≥ 1.
invalid_move.cannot_bet: Awi karhi ngi [bet] - swi fanele ngi [call] / [raise] / [fold].
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: A ku na lexi u nga xi vitanaka; ematshan'weni ya sweswo, [check].
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Tirhisa [bet X] ku pfula; a ka ha ri na mali yo tlakusa.
invalid_move.insufficient: A ku na tichipisi leti eneleke eka xiendlo xexo.

message.showdown_win: Ku kombisa ku vilela: {card_win} yi tlula {card_lose}.
message.showdown_tie: Kuhlanganisa: {card} yin'we. Mphikwa wa mphikwa – un'wana na un'wana u kuma {split}.

outcome.draw: Swiphemu leswi ringanaka endzhaku ka minxaxamelo hinkwayo
